findings.message: The test case assigns the approval action to warehouse_operator, while REQ-AUTH-001 permits approval only by sales_manager. Rewriting the actor or selecting an authorization failure outcome would require an unsupported product decision; provide a role and expected result consistent with the stated authorization policy.
evidence: REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
